turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good afternoon, and welcome to Fairmont Fitness. Can I help you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Hi, yes. I'd like to join the club, if that's possible. I've walked past a few times on my way back from lectures and I finally decided to come in and ask.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Lovely. You've picked a good week, actually, because we're not charging the joining fee at the moment, so that's one less thing to worry about. Have you used a gym before?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Only the tiny one in my halls of residence, which has two running machines and a broken bench. So this is going to be a big step up, I think.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ha, well, we do have a bit more than that. Right, let me start your form. Can I take your first name, please?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It's Rhiannon, R-H-I-A-N-N-O-N. People always leave out one of the Ns, so I've got used to spelling it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Got it, with two Ns in the middle and one at the end. And your date of birth, Rhiannon?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The 15th of September, I mean, no, sorry, the 16th of September. My sister's birthday is the day before mine, so I always mix them up.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No problem at all, the 16th it is. A lot of people get dates muddled when they're filling in forms, so don't worry about it. Now, I need your home town for the system. Where do you live?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I rent a room just outside the city, with two other students. It's Ottersham, O-T-T-E-R-S-H-A-M.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Ottersham, lovely. Now, we ask everyone for an emergency contact, in case anything happens while you're training. Is there someone we can put down, and what's their surname?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Probably my older brother, since he lives closest to me and he's usually got his phone on him. His surname is Hallam, same as my parents.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Perfect, I'll put that down. Next is your student card number. You said you're at the university, so you'll have one, and with it we can give you the student rate on the monthly price.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, hang on, I'll get it out of my bag. It's four, one, three, zero.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Four-one-thirty?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, four, one, three, zero. 4130.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thanks, that's right, 4130. And which campus do you study at? We get quite a few students from the Northgate campus as well, though that's a fair way from us.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh, the Northgate one is miles away, I'd never come here from there. I'm at Riverside, which is a short walk from here, and that's why I chose this club.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That makes sense, it's very convenient for you. Right, nearly there. When would you like to start? We run a free induction session for new members, so I'll need to book you in as well, and one of the trainers will show you round.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Thursday, I think. Oh no, wait, I've got a seminar then. Wednesday would be better, if there's a space.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: There is a space, so Wednesday it is. I'll book you in for the induction session and put a note on your account so the trainer knows you're coming. Now, what time of day do you usually like to work out?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: In the evening, after my last lecture. I can't face doing anything before breakfast, to be honest.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good to know. Now, the last practical thing is a locker, which most of our members like to have. There's a £10 deposit for the key, I should say, but you get it back when you hand the key in. I've got one free at the end of the row, and I'll read the number off the tag. It says locker thirty-one forty.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sorry, I think I can see the tag from here. No, it's three, one, four, zero. 3140, it's written on the key.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My mistake, 3140, thank you. Finally, how are you hoping to fit the gym around your timetable? It helps us to know, because the quiet times change from week to week.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'd like to come in three times, I think, spread across the weekdays, so that I don't burn out in the first month.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's a sensible plan. Right, that's everything I need. Let me print out your membership details and your card, and then I'll show you the way to the changing rooms. Enjoy your first session!

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Thank you so much. I'm really looking forward to it.
